summary: Top Ships Inc. filed a Form 6-K on October 1, 2026 attaching a September 30, 2026 press release announcing closing of the previously announced share purchase agreement dated July 28, 2026 with a related-party seller. Top Ships acquired the shares of three SPVs, each party to a shipbuilding contract for one high-specification, ECO, scrubber-fitted 50,000 dwt MR product tanker delivering in 2029. The SPVs secured five-year firm time charters with an oil major commencing at delivery, plus a one-year charterer extension option. No purchase price, premium or board recommendation disclosed; related-party nature and 2029 deliveries are key watch items for valuation and governance risk.
